    How a project runs

    Short, clear, and in both languages. You always know what happens next.

    01

    Discover

    A call about your business, your customers, and what the website has to do for you.

    02

    Design

    You see the real design early — pages, colours, words — and we shape it together.

    03

    Build

    Fast, bilingual, mobile-first. Built to load in a blink and read clearly on any screen.

    04

    Grow

    SEO, ads and content that keep bringing people in long after launch day.

    Questions, answered

    The things Montréal businesses ask us most.

    Do you build websites in French and English?
    Yes — bilingual is our default. Every page is written and designed in both languages, not machine-translated after the fact.
    Why do the first 3 seconds matter so much?
    Visitors decide almost instantly whether a site feels trustworthy. A slow, cluttered first screen sends them to a competitor. We design the opening screen to answer "am I in the right place?" immediately.
    Can you take care of everything — site, logo, ads, SEO?
    That's the point of FMBytex: one team for your website, branding, advertising and SEO & growth, so everything looks and sounds like one brand.
    How do we start?
    Send us a message through fmbytex.com. Tell us what you do and what you want the website to do — we'll come back with honest next steps.
